usage: OFFLINE EVALUATION ONLY. Do not inject into runtime prompts, behavior rules, POI prices or calibration objectives.

study.title: 당구장 등 실내 체육시설의 금연구역 확대 정책 전후비교: 경제적 영향 및 흡연노출 평가를 중심으로

card_data.measurement: 신한카드 건수/금액을 기반으로 시장전체 카드건수/금액으로 환산한 추정값
card_data.sample_size_note: 핵심 회귀표 12/14에는 패널 관측 수 N이 제시되지 않는다. 전체 카드사 고객 수나 설문 표본을 회귀 N으로 사용하지 않는다.
card_data.method: Linear regression with administrative-dong fixed effects and panel-corrected standard errors, AR(1); Stata 13 xtpcse correlation(ar1)
card_data.data_anomaly: 잠실 실내골프 업소의 2018-06 온라인 매출 혼입에 대해 잠실 제외 및 대체값 분석을 수행했다(인쇄 p19).

survey.method: Owners/workers: site visits; users: online survey panel; self-reported answers.
survey.linkage: Individual before/after respondent linkage is not established in the cited methods; do not assume a paired individual panel.

environment_monitoring.pairing: The three billiard facilities were retained. Two indoor golf facilities were replaced after closure/business changes/remodeling; only the Seocho golf facility was retained.
environment_monitoring.geography: Before: billiards in Seocho/Nowon/Songpa, golf in Seocho/Songpa/Guro. After: billiards in the same locations, golf in Seocho/Nowon/Songpa.

metrics.estimand: Adjusted year-indicator association in log card-market revenue, not an unadjusted before/after ratio or proven policy causal effect.
metrics.conversion: 100 * (exp(beta) - 1); 13.54 is the report's rounded result. Do not replace it by beta * 100.
metrics.comparison_rule: Report direction and percentage-point distance descriptively after freezing the first simulation. A counterfactual AB estimate differs from this observational estimand; no pass/fail accuracy tolerance is asserted.

metrics.estimand: Adjusted year-indicator association in log card payment events.
metrics.comparison_rule: Non-significance is not a zero effect, equivalence margin or measured visit count. Do not score against zero.

metrics.estimand: Adjusted year-indicator association in log card-market revenue.
metrics.comparison_rule: Use as diagnostic context; do not score against a zero target.

metrics.estimand: Adjusted year-indicator association in log card payment events.
metrics.comparison_rule: Use as diagnostic context; do not score against a zero target or treat events as unique people.

descriptive_before_after.purpose: Separate unadjusted descriptive card-data summaries; not the regression benchmark or causal effects.
descriptive_before_after.source_discrepancy: Narrative p26 gives Seocho billiard 2018 revenue as 7278.6; table 9 gives 6915.0. This transcription follows the visually verified table and flags the inconsistency.

context_only.before_question: Expected revenue change after the policy
context_only.after_question: Perceived revenue change after the policy
context_only.evaluation_use: Do not convert response shares into revenue changes or use them as simulated transaction targets.

context_only.method: Indoor primary test method; distinct from real-time monitor results.
context_only.evaluation_use: Out of scope for an economic/mobility simulation without an exposure/ventilation model; partially replaced golf facilities preclude a fully paired facility interpretation.

context_only.method: Indoor primary test method; distinct from real-time monitor results.
context_only.evaluation_use: Not a spending target and not directly derivable from simulated visits or smoking status.

calibration_allowed: independently sourced pre-policy POIs, prices and activity rates
validation_design.first_run: Freeze model/version, inputs, assignment seed and run seeds before opening evaluator output; preserve the first outcome unchanged.
validation_design.after_tuning: If outcomes guide a later model revision, mark that revision calibrated on this report; it no longer has independent holdout validity against the same targets.
validation_design.ab_comparability: Same-period policy OFF/ON simulations estimate a modeled counterfactual. Report results beside the study's adjusted observational association with the estimand mismatch explicitly stated.
validation_design.baseline_zero: Return undefined for percent change when OFF spending or transactions equals zero; do not insert an epsilon and claim a percentage effect.
validation_design.uncertainty: Summarize paired seed effects and Monte Carlo variability separately from the empirical study's sampling uncertainty.
limitations: Three purposively selected Seoul districts; no citywide representativeness claim
No untreated comparison group establishing a policy-only causal effect
Time trends and billiard popularity may explain the adjusted increase
Study policy coding starts January 2018, after the December 2017 legal start
Contemporary POIs/personas are not a reconstructed 2017 population
Survey expectations and perceived changes differ from realized card outcomes
